title: Music Row Mansion in Nashville
description: Music Row – widely considered the heart of Nashville's music industry is a prime location that offers historic charm and easy access to the city’s top attractions. This beautifully remodeled vintage space on Music Row with eight bedrooms and 6 baths, making it ideal for families or groups seeking an authentic Nashville experience. This location has exploded with new and trendy restaurants, venues, and shops in the past few years. It is close to everything, very quiet and peaceful at night.
